description.value: You single out one creature you can see and lance its mind with psychic force. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 3d8 psychic damage (half as much on a success), and on a failed save you become aware of its exact location for as long as you both remain on the same planet — it cannot hide from you, and gains no benefit from invisibility against you. This power has no effect on droids or constructs.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 2
